description.value: Top in Town Pizza & Wings is a family-owned pizza and wings chain operating since 2009, with this Langley location serving dine-in, delivery, and takeout. The menu leans into South Asian-influenced flavours alongside classic Canadian pizza staples, with a notably broad vegetarian selection including paneer-topped pies. A solid hot-meal stop for touring cyclists passing through the Willowbrook area of Langley.

The website's postal code (V2Y 0L3) differs from OSM (V3A 5E6), and the website provides a Langley-specific phone number absent from OSM. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content, but the extensive vegetarian pizza section (Karahi Paneer, Ultimate Veggie, Full Punjabi, etc.) confirms vegetarian options.
